brief:
Israeli occupation forces closed multiple commercial shops in Hawara south of Nablus on Tuesday morning and barred their owners from reopening, Shehab Wire reported. The action targeted an unspecified number of businesses in the town.

The closures represent a new phase in restrictions on commercial movement in Hawara. The measures come as part of what Israeli authorities describe as security operations in the area, though Palestinian officials characterize them as collective punishment. Hawara, located south of the West Bank city of Nablus, has faced repeated restrictions on Palestinian economic activity and movement in recent months.
